bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'SERVER_CORE_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_BRANCH='; git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai branch --show-current
printf 'DEBUGAI_DIRTY_COUNT='; git -C /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai status --porcelain | wc -l
printf 'DEBUGAI_CONTAINERS\n'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' | grep -E '^(debug-ai|ai-|server-core-bounded-host)' || true
